answer: A payout is split which means 25% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The meadow schedule is applied in ridge and sparrow shows each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3887 identities would post 2442 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
